description: This source file defines the RemoveValue class, which implements a MethodOperation for the MiniLang language in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles the '<remove-value>' element, responsible for removing an entity value specified by a flexible attribute accessor.

classes.name: RemoveValue
classes.description: Implements a method operation to remove an entity value based on a flexible attribute reference, used within the MiniLang framework of OFBiz.

classes.description: Factory class to create instances of RemoveValue for the '<remove-value>' element.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on the XML element and simple method context.
